albion.question: What is the method for the path to Toronto?

direct.text: To reach Toronto: either pay Ohl a Jewel (meet via the Miner’s Guild schedule) or follow the “stones to coastline then south” route to the cave entrance.

claims.text: To reach Toronto: either pay Ohl a Jewel (meet via the Miner’s Guild schedule) or follow the “stones to coastline then south” route to the cave entrance.

ultima5.question: What is the method for the Sandalwood Box?

direct.text: Stand at the harpsichord and play Stones as 6-7-8-9-8-7-8-7-6-7-6-5-3. The secret wall opens; enter and take the Sandalwood Box.
